note: Pinned per docs/decisions/0002: the tarball above was fetched from the official npm registry and its integrity was verified against the registry-published dist.integrity value before extraction. Bundle contents ship verbatim from the pin; the runtime provenance test re-hashes key files (loader.js, editor/editor.main.js, editor/editor.main.css, monaco-pinned.json self-check) against pre-computed digests so CI fails if any pinned byte drifts. The TypeScript language worker embeds the TypeScript compiler (Apache-2.0).
